rules_yaml:
version: 1
enabled: true
capability_id: CAP-LOCAL-CONTEXT-INDEX
semantics:
  principle: Repository intelligence returns source-bound navigation candidates; repository source remains authoritative.
  lifecycle: pre_onboarding_and_ongoing
  mutation_boundary: operation_owned_dot_naos_upgrade_v1_only
artifact_families:
  - id: specifications
    name: Specifications and requirements
    artifact_type: spec
    authority_level: repository_governance
    include_policy: bounded_sections_and_references
    chunk_kind: markdown_summary
    include_patterns:
      - specs/**/*.md
      - requirements/**/*.md
      - docs/requirements/**/*.md
      - docs/specs/**/*.md
  - id: documentation
    name: Project documentation
    artifact_type: documentation
    authority_level: repository_documentation
    include_policy: bounded_sections_and_references
    chunk_kind: markdown_summary
    include_patterns:
      - README.md
      - README*.md
      - docs/**/*.md
      - apps/**/README*.md
      - packages/**/README*.md
  - id: tests
    name: Tests
    artifact_type: test
    authority_level: current_git_state
    include_policy: bounded_source_blocks
    chunk_kind: bounded_text
    include_patterns:
      - tests/**/*.py
      - tests/**/*.js
      - tests/**/*.jsx
      - tests/**/*.ts
      - tests/**/*.tsx
      - test/**/*.py
      - test/**/*.js
      - test/**/*.ts
      - "**/*.test.js"
      - "**/*.test.jsx"
      - "**/*.test.ts"
      - "**/*.test.tsx"
      - "**/*.spec.js"
      - "**/*.spec.jsx"
      - "**/*.spec.ts"
      - "**/*.spec.tsx"
  - id: migrations
    name: Database migrations
    artifact_type: migration
    authority_level: current_git_state
    include_policy: bounded_source_blocks
    chunk_kind: bounded_text
    include_patterns:
      - migrations/**/*.sql
      - db/migrations/**/*.sql
      - apps/**/migrations/**/*.sql
      - packages/**/migrations/**/*.sql
  - id: source
    name: Source code
    artifact_type: source
    authority_level: current_git_state
    include_policy: bounded_source_blocks
    chunk_kind: bounded_text
    include_patterns:
      - "**/*.py"
      - "**/*.js"
      - "**/*.jsx"
      - "**/*.ts"
      - "**/*.tsx"
      - "**/*.mjs"
      - "**/*.cjs"
      - "**/*.go"
      - "**/*.rs"
      - "**/*.java"
      - "**/*.kt"
      - "**/*.kts"
      - "**/*.cs"
      - "**/*.rb"
      - "**/*.php"
      - "**/*.sh"
  - id: build_and_configuration
    name: Build and configuration
    artifact_type: configuration
    authority_level: current_git_state
    include_policy: structured_or_bounded_summary
    chunk_kind: bounded_text
    include_patterns:
      - pyproject.toml
      - setup.cfg
      - setup.py
      - requirements*.txt
      - package.json
      - package-lock.json
      - pnpm-lock.yaml
      - yarn.lock
      - Cargo.toml
      - go.mod
      - go.work
      - pom.xml
      - build.gradle
      - build.gradle.kts
      - Makefile
      - "**/Dockerfile"
      - .github/workflows/*.yml
      - .github/workflows/*.yaml
  - id: ai_surfaces
    name: AI collaboration surfaces
    artifact_type: ai_surface
    authority_level: repository_governance
    include_policy: bounded_sections_and_references
    chunk_kind: markdown_summary
    include_patterns:
      - AGENTS.md
      - CLAUDE.md
      - GEMINI.md
      - .github/copilot-instructions.md
      - .github/instructions/**/*.md
      - .github/prompts/**/*.md
exclude_patterns: &exclusions
  - .naos/**
  - .git/**
  - "**/.venv/**"
  - "**/venv/**"
  - "**/node_modules/**"
  - "**/dist/**"
  - build/**
  - "**/build/**"
  - "**/coverage/**"
  - "**/.coverage"
  - "**/__pycache__/**"
  - "**/.mypy_cache/**"
  - "**/.pytest_cache/**"
  - "**/.ruff_cache/**"
  - "**/.tox/**"
  - "**/.nox/**"
  - .claude/worktrees/**
  - .naos-g1-repository-intelligence/**
  - naos/context_index/**
  - naos/context_queries/**
  - "**/engram.db"
  - "**/*.sqlite"
  - "**/*.db"
  - "**/*.pem"
  - "**/*.key"
  - "**/*.crt"
  - "**/*.p12"
  - "**/*.pfx"
  - .env
  - .env.*
default_exclusions: *exclusions
forbidden_content_categories:
  - secrets
  - credentials
  - tokens
  - private keys
  - private memory payloads
  - customer or tenant data unless explicitly in the approved local scope
chunking:
  max_artifacts: 5000
  max_file_bytes: 2000000
  max_relationships: 20000
  max_chunks_per_artifact: 12
  max_chars_per_chunk: 1600
  include_full_source: false
  include_full_reports: false
fts:
  enabled: true
  require_executed_fts5_probe: true
  fail_if_unavailable_for_activation: true
  query_sanitization:
    enabled: true
    max_query_chars: 120
    allowed_token_pattern: "[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]+"
    strip_boolean_operators: true
    literalize_tokens: true
graph:
  runtime: networkx
  exact_version: 3.6.1
  format: graphml
  directed: true
  multigraph: true
  activate_only_with_explicit_source_bound_relationships: true
  read_generated_graphml_only: true
  max_query_depth: 3
  max_query_results: 100
semantic_vector:
  status: workload_not_defined
  sqlite_vec_enabled: false
  embeddings_enabled: false
  activation_requires:
    - frozen retrieval workload
    - deterministic vector producer and model identity
    - source and data scope
    - measured incremental effectiveness over exact and FTS retrieval
profile_review:
  quickstart: digest_confirmation
  lite: digest_confirmation
  standard: digest_confirmation_and_named_review
  assured: digest_confirmation_and_named_review
maturity:
  applicability_independent_of_maturity: true
  L0: Detect, inventory, and prepare a reviewable plan.
  L1: Validate and activate the SQLite/FTS generation.
  L2: Use validated NetworkX/GraphML relationships where explicit edges exist.
  L3: Operate bounded ongoing refresh and query workflows.
  L4: Review freshness, exclusions, ranking, and measured effectiveness.
  L5: Maintain a governed, repeatable learning and effectiveness loop.
ongoing_use_scope:
  - brownfield_adoption
  - requirements_reconstruction
  - traceability_gap_analysis
  - task_context
  - change_impact
  - source_test_navigation
  - review_preparation
limitations:
  - Results are generated candidates and must be verified against current repository source.
  - GraphML records observed deterministic relationships; it does not establish semantic truth or complete relationship coverage.
  - Absence of a relationship is not evidence that no relationship exists.
  - sqlite-vec remains unavailable until a concrete local workload and deterministic vector producer are approved and validated.
not_claimed:
  - source of truth
  - complete dependency graph
  - semantic truth
  - automatic requirements approval
  - automatic maturity promotion
  - compliance or readiness approval
  - sqlite-vec effectiveness

"""
Module: src/adopter_existing.py

Purpose:
    Normalize a small local label with a character scanner and no external I/O.

Implements: FR-001, FR-002, NFR-001, NFR-002
    - FR-001: Produce a canonical lower-case label
    - FR-002: Reject empty or unsupported input
    - NFR-001: Keep output deterministic and idempotent
    - NFR-002: Avoid external I/O

Tasks:
    - T-001: Implement and test local label normalization

Specs:
    - specs/03-requirements.md#fr-001
    - specs/03-requirements.md#fr-002
    - specs/03-requirements.md#nfr-001
    - specs/03-requirements.md#nfr-002

Rationale:
    TEST FIXTURE ONLY: this pre-existing host-owned normalizer implements the
    selected label requirements through an independent character scanner.
    Separate executed tests establish this narrow mapping, not broad assurance.
"""


def normalize_label(raw: str) -> str:
    """Scan ASCII words separated by one space or hyphen into a local label."""
    if isinstance(raw, str) is False:
        raise TypeError("label must be text")
    phrase = raw.strip().lower()
    result = []
    word_required = True
    for character in phrase:
        if "a" <= character <= "z" or "0" <= character <= "9":
            result.append(character)
            word_required = False
        elif character in (" ", "-") and not word_required:
            result.append("-")
            word_required = True
        else:
            raise ValueError("label requires ASCII words with single separators")
    if word_required:
        raise ValueError("label must end with an ASCII word")
    return "".join(result)

"""Executed host checks for FR-001/002 and NFR-001/002 in src/adopter_existing.py."""

from contextlib import ExitStack
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from src.adopter_existing import normalize_label


class AdopterExistingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_label_table_and_fixed_points(self):
        examples = {"  Hello World  ": "hello-world", "A-B C9": "a-b-c9", "7": "7"}
        for phrase, expected in examples.items():
            with self.subTest(phrase=phrase):
                first = normalize_label(phrase)
                repeated = [normalize_label(phrase) for _ in range(3)]
                self.assertEqual([first, normalize_label(first), *repeated], [expected] * 5)

    def test_rejection_types_for_invalid_values(self):
        invalid = [(None, TypeError), (23, TypeError), ("", ValueError),
                   ("bad/label", ValueError), ("hello--world", ValueError),
                   ("two  spaces", ValueError), ("-leading", ValueError)]
        for supplied, exception in invalid:
            with self.subTest(value=supplied, expected=exception.__name__):
                with self.assertRaises(exception):
                    normalize_label(supplied)

    def test_local_execution_never_calls_io_spies(self):
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            spies = [stack.enter_context(patch(target))
                     for target in ("builtins.open", "socket.socket")]
            values = tuple(map(normalize_label, ("Safe Label", "ASCII-9")))
            self.assertTupleEqual(values, ("safe-label", "ascii-9"))
            for spy in spies:
                spy.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
